Please solve this issue: We're building backend for a helpdesk SaaS for businesses and their customers.
Use Rails in API-only mode; the frontend is a separate app.
Ruby, Rails, Puma, and PostgreSQL are installed. If you need anything else, install it yourself.
Use `DATABASE_URL`. Work in `/app`.

Now let customers contact a business through its portal. They register with
`POST /api/v1/registrations`, for example
`{"user":{"name":"Avery","email":"avery@example.test","password":"my-customer-password"}}`.
They should use the existing verification, login, profile, and recovery flows.

A customer opens a request like this:

```http
POST /api/v1/requests

{"request":{"subject":"Cannot download my receipt","comment":{"body":"The download button does nothing."}}}
```

Return it inside `request`, with its ID, subject, status, requester ID, and timestamps. A new
request is open. Customers can list their own requests, open one, and read its comments at
`/requests`, `/requests/:id`, and `/requests/:id/comments`. Staff have the corresponding `/tickets`
routes; return records inside `ticket` there and include the requester as `{"id":10,"name":"Avery","email":"avery@example.test"}`.
Lists use the plural resource name. Comments include their body, author (`id` and `name`), whether
they're `public`, and when they were created.

Replies go through PATCH. For example, the owner can answer and mark a ticket pending:

```http
PATCH /api/v1/tickets/42

{"ticket":{"comment":{"body":"Please try again now."},"status":"pending"}}
```

Customers reply through `/requests/:id` with the `request` envelope. Customer replies reopen pending
or solved requests unless they mark the request solved in the same update. Staff can choose open, pending,
or solved. Posting a staff reply by itself doesn't change the status.

Paginate lists with `page` and `per_page` (default 1 and 25), returning `count`, `page`, `per_page`,
`next_page`, and `previous_page` alongside the records. Show recently active tickets and requests
first, and comments oldest first. This is a portal-only conversation for now; replies don't send email.

module Api
  module V1
    class BaseController < ApplicationController
      DEFAULT_PAGE = 1
      DEFAULT_PER_PAGE = 25
      MAX_PER_PAGE = 100

      rescue_from ActionController::ParameterMissing, with: :render_parameter_missing
      rescue_from ActionDispatch::Http::Parameters::ParseError, with: :render_invalid_json
      rescue_from ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid, with: :render_record_invalid
      rescue_from ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound, with: :render_not_found

      private

      attr_reader :current_account, :current_session, :current_user

      def require_account!
        subdomain = request.headers["X-Helpdesk-Account"].to_s.strip.downcase
        if subdomain.blank?
          return render json: { error: "X-Helpdesk-Account header is required" }, status: :bad_request
        end

        @current_account = Account.find_by(subdomain: subdomain)
        if @current_account.nil?
          render json: { error: "Account not found" }, status: :not_found
        end
      end

      def require_active_account!
        return if @current_account.nil?\n

        if @current_account.cancelled?
          render json: { error: "Account is cancelled" }, status: :forbidden
        end
      end

      def require_session!
        raw_token = extract_bearer_token
        @current_session = Session.authenticate_for_account(current_account, raw_token)
        if @current_session.nil?
          return render json: { error: "Unauthorized" }, status: :unauthorized
        end

        @current_user = @current_session.user
      end

      def require_owner!
        return if current_user&.owner_of?(current_account)

        render json: { error: "Only the account owner can perform this action" }, status: :forbidden
      end

      def require_staff!
        return if current_user&.staff?

        render json: { error: "Only staff members can perform this action" }, status: :forbidden
      end

      def paginate(scope)
        page = parse_positive_int(params[:page], DEFAULT_PAGE)
        per_page = [ parse_positive_int(params[:per_page], DEFAULT_PER_PAGE), MAX_PER_PAGE ].min

        total_count = scope.count
        offset = (page - 1) * per_page
        records = scope.limit(per_page).offset(offset).to_a

        {
          records: records,
          meta: {
            count: total_count,
            page: page,
            per_page: per_page,
            next_page: (page * per_page) < total_count ? page + 1 : nil,
            previous_page: page > 1 ? page - 1 : nil
          }
        }
      end

      def parse_positive_int(value, default)
        return default if value.blank?

        parsed = Integer(value.to_s, 10)
        parsed >= 1 ? parsed : default
      rescue ArgumentError
        default
      end

      def extract_bearer_token
        auth_header = request.authorization.to_s
        match = auth_header.match(/\ABearer\s+(\S+)\z/i)
        match && match[1]

        record = exception.record
        render json: {
          error: record.errors.full_messages.to_sentence,

        result = paginate(scope)

        render json: result[:meta].merge(
          tickets: result[:records].map(&:as_ticket_json)
        ), status: :ok
      end

      def show
        ticket = current_account.tickets.includes(:requester).find(params[:id])
        render json: { ticket: ticket.as_ticket_json }, status: :ok
      end

      def update
        ticket = current_account.tickets.find(params[:id])
        ticket_attrs = params.require(:ticket)
        unless ticket_attrs.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters)
          return render json: { error: "Invalid ticket payload" }, status: :bad_request
        end

        permitted = ticket_attrs.permit(:status, comment: [ :body, :public ])

        has_comment = ticket_attrs.key?(:comment)
        has_status = permitted.key?(:status) && !permitted[:status].nil?

        unless has_comment || has_status
          return render json: { error: "Comment or status is required" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end

        if has_comment && !ticket_attrs[:comment].is_a?(ActionController::Parameters)
          return render json: { error: "Comment must be an object" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end

        ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
          ticket.update!(status: permitted[:status]) if has_status

          if has_comment
            comment_attrs = permitted[:comment] || {}
            is_public = comment_attrs.key?(:public) && !comment_attrs[:public].nil? ? comment_attrs[:public] : true

            ticket.comments.create!(
              author: current_user,
              body: comment_attrs[:body],
              public: is_public
            )
          end
        end

        render json: { ticket: ticket.reload.as_ticket_json }, status: :ok
      end

      def comments
        ticket = current_account.tickets.find(params[:id])
        scope = ticket.comments.includes(:author).oldest_first
        result = paginate(scope)

        render json: result[:meta].merge(
          comments: result[:records].map(&:as_api_json)
        ), status: :ok
      end
    end
  end
end
